#en: A station like this was supposed to host short-term trials and emergency protocols, not keep them humming in the background for generations. But habits harden, staff change, and what began as provisional containment has settled into routine: anonymous specimens tagged, stored, and fed through machines that no one bothers to question anymore. If any trace of what he is trying to map was ever captured in flesh or residue, it will be catalogued here as just another anomaly in a system that forgot it was temporary. So far the trail runs from a corrupted slate on a nameless rock, to falsified records on a wandering freighter, to a forgotten military archive each step pointing to someone quietly turning improvised workarounds into standing practice, and bending those practices into a way to move unseen between the lanes.
zh: 像这样的星际站本只该承载短期试验与应急协议，而不是让它们一代代地在后台嗡鸣。可习惯会硬化、人员会更换，起初只是临时围控的东西逐渐沉淀成了例行：匿名样本被标记、储存，喂进再没人费心质疑的机器里。若说他试图绘制的任何东西曾在血肉或残留物中被捕捉到，那它也会被当作这套"忘了自己只是临时"的系统里又一处异常编入目录。目前为止，线索从一块无名岩石上损坏的数据板，到一艘漂游货船上被伪造的记录，再到一座被遗忘的军事档案库，每一步都指向有人在悄悄把临时的变通变成常设做法，并把这些做法掰成一条在航道之间隐形移动的路。

#en: The abandoned depot is where forgotten cargo comes to rest and paperwork comes to die, which is exactly why this place still matters. Its racks are full of containers that never matched their manifests, tagged with routing codes no one admits to issuing, overseen by contractors who swear they only guard "generic assets." Grid Warbrand holds the ground with the bored focus of people paid to ignore the fine print, but the routing clusters here still hum with patterns that do not belong to any sanctioned lane. So far the trail has been built from things everyone pretends not to remember: a stray signature from that lonely rock, incomplete schedules from the quiet lab, a shuttered relay that logged traffic after shutdown, and dockside gossip in Gagarin Landing about a tug that always left light and was never challenged.
zh: 那座废弃货运站，是被遗忘货物停下、文书死去的地方——这正是这地方至今仍要紧的原因。它的货架塞满了从未与舱单对上的货柜，标签上是不承认自己签发过的航线路由代码，由那些发誓只守卫"普通资产"的承包商看着。网格战痕帮以"被雇来无视细则的人"那种无聊的专注守在这里，可这里的路由簇仍在嗡鸣着不属于任何获批航道的模式。目前为止，这条线索是由所有人都假装不记得的东西搭成的：那块孤独岩石上的一道散落签名、那座安静实验室里不完整的日程、一座关机后仍在记录交通的关闭中继，以及加加林着陆点码头边关于一艘总在轻载离港、从未被拦查的拖船的闲话。

#en: A GalBank contract hauler should never drift this far off its lane, yet BX-1113 Creditforge hangs in the dark like a cancelled debt, its running lights dead, its registry still quietly billing hours no one has checked in months. This is where the numbers and the routes intersect, where a logistics workhorse doubled as a vault for the wrong kind of ledger, humming along the same corridors Vector once calibrated. In its cargo logs and nav cores, you are not just chasing one man, but the silent tolerance that let his corrections ride unchallenged across the network. So far the trail has been a forgotten dataslate on a fringe rock and buried notes from a nervous corporate contact, all pointing toward altered corridors, missing ships, and a cartographer whose fingerprints keep surfacing in the margins of official records.
zh: 一艘盖尔银行的合同货船本绝不该漂离航道这么远，可"BX-1113 信贷熔炉"像一笔被注销的债务悬在黑暗中：航行灯熄灭，登记册却仍在悄悄计费，而那些工时已好几个月没人查过。这里正是数字与航线相交之处，是某台物流主力兼作那种"错误账册"的金库之处，沿着"向量"曾经校准过的同样走廊嗡鸣。在它的货运日志与导航核心里，你追的不只是一个人，而是那种让他的修正得以在网络中不受质疑地穿行的沉默容忍。目前为止，这条线索是一块边缘岩石上被遗忘的数据板，以及某个紧张的内部联系人埋下的笔记，全都指向被改动的走廊、失踪的船只，以及一名指纹不断在官方记录页边浮现的制图师。

#en: The farm sits exactly where her math needs it to be, a quiet notch between patrol sweeps and commercial lanes, a place early LIST planners marked as convenient refuel and every smuggler since learned to forget. Here the airfields and broken silos hide a ship that can spin up without drawing distant eyes, and the soil still holds cables from when this was a refit stop for haulers testing risky shortcuts. Now Vector folds her grief and stolen telemetry into one last set of calculations, close enough to the line she has been sketching across half the map. No one out here knows the full story, only fragments traded in low voices: a burnt courier's slate on a dead rock, a shaken Fleet liaison in a rusting drop shelter, murmurs in Neon's shadows that her routes draw an invisible curve back to a convoy that never came home.
zh: 这座农场恰好坐落在她的数学需要它在的位置：巡逻圈与商业航道之间一道安静的凹口，一处早期独立盟规划者标记为便利补给点、而此后每个走私者都学会忘掉的地方。在这里，简易机场与破损筒仓藏着一艘能不引来远方目光就点火的船，土壤里仍埋着线缆——那时这里还是货运船测试冒险近路的中转站。如今"向量"把她的悲伤与偷来的遥测折进最后一组计算，离她半张地图上一直在勾勒的那条线足够近。这外面没人知道完整的故事，只有低声交换的碎片：死寂岩石上一块烧毁信使的数据板、某座锈蚀投放掩体里一名心有余悸的舰队联络官，以及霓虹城阴影里的低语——说她的航线画出一条无形的弧线，绕回一支从未回家的车队。

#en: Ebbside is where the city forgets what time it is, where shifts blur together and nobody notices when one more crate starts moving under the wrong name. If someone wanted to buy adjustments to their weather and tuck the payments into everyday freight, this is where the paperwork would vanish into the background noise of liquor runs, chem drops, and replacement filters. Hidden in those routine manifests is the list of who has been paying for storms, and from that, a pattern of worlds she keeps circling back to.  \nUp to now the trail has only given me fragments: an anonymous tip from the fringe, cautious files at a support post, refinery readings that did not match their own reports; all hinting that what began as "special deliveries" became standard practice long before anyone thought to ask who signed for the skies.
zh: 埃布赛德是这座城市忘记时间的地方，班次彼此模糊，没人注意又多了一个货箱以错误的名义开始移动。若有人想给自己买天气调整、并把款项塞进日常货运里，这里就是那些文书会化进酒类运输、化学空投与更换滤芯的背景噪声之处。藏在那些例行舱单里的，是"谁一直在为风暴付钱"的清单，而由它可以推出一串她不断绕回的世界。  \n目前为止，这条线索只给了我碎片：来自边境的一条匿名线报、某座补给站里谨慎的文件、与其他报告不符的炼油读数；全都暗示着，起初的"特别配送"早在任何人想起问"是谁替天空签收"之前就已成了标准做法。

#en: Out here in high orbit, this sliver of hardware is the only thing that still remembers how the lanes really run. The array was never meant to be interesting a maintenance waypoint, a passive relay, the kind of thing captains ignore while they worry about fuel and docking slots. Then its update schedule slipped, its handshake pattern shifted by a few milliseconds, and someone rerouted a patrol to sit on top of it without changing the public charts. A Spacer hull like BR-8628 Shatterjaw does not park over dead metal for nothing; whatever is buried in that signal trail is worth guarding in gun range. So far the trail is nothing but altered timetables and traffic rumors quiet changes in approach windows, new vectors filed under old codes, routines that bent a little each week until nobody could remember when they started.
zh: 在这里的高轨道上，这一小片硬件是唯一仍记得航道真正如何运行的东西。那座阵列本不该有任何意思——一个维护航点、一座被动中继，船长们在操心燃料与泊位时会忽略的那种东西。然后它的更新日程滑了、握手模式偏移了几毫秒，而有人不经改动公开星图就把一支巡逻队调到它上方压着。像"BR-8628 碎颚"这样的太空劫匪船壳不会无缘无故停在死金属上方；埋在那些信号轨迹里的任何东西，都值得用枪炮射程守着。目前为止，这条线索无非是被改动的时间表与交通传闻：进近窗口的安静变化、以旧代码归档的新向量，以及每周都弯一点、直到没人记得它们何时开始的惯例。

#en: The Voyager AX-1329 hangs cold and lightless, a Trade Authority hulk that should have been towed long ago, if its last manifests had matched what the docks expected to see. Instead, it slipped between schedules and signatures, stranded in a patch of quiet space where no one would question a little missing cargo or a few extra welds. Its idle cranes and frozen conveyors mark it as the only place where freight, identity, and trajectory could have been rewritten cleanly enough to hide a moving yard in plain sight. The trail up to here is a chain of near-misses and overlooked warnings: a forgotten slate in a remote shed, monitoring logs at an abandoned relay that flagged unregistered work barges, then half-scrubbed entries in an old listening post that hinted someone was bending the lanes without ever quite breaking them.
zh: 旅行者 AX-1329冷寂无光地悬着，一艘本该早就被拖走的贸易管理局残骸——如果它最后几份舱单与码头预期的相符的话。可它偏偏从日程与签名之间滑了出去，搁浅在一片没人会质疑"少了一点货物、多了几道焊缝"的安静太空中。它闲置的吊臂与冻结的传送带，标志着它是唯一能让"货物、身份与轨迹"被干净改写、从而把一个移动船坞藏在明面上的地方。通往这里的线索是一连串惊险擦碰与被忽略的警告：偏远棚屋里一块被遗忘的数据板、某座废弃中继处标记了未登记作业驳船的监控日志，然后是一座旧听音哨里半擦除的条目，暗示有人一直在掰弯航道、却从未真正把它们掰断。

#en: Where the debris thins and the stars feel too close, the last working machinery in this graveyard is still quietly doing its job, shunting phantom triage routes and evac paths along a line nobody remembers authorizing. As long as that logic loop keeps running, wounded ships and desperate crews will keep drifting the same way, and he will always have a reason to be waiting at the end of it. Breaking the chain here means cutting into the nervous system of some forgotten war protocol before it can drag anyone else into his hands.  \nSo far all I have are fragments of a pattern: an anonymous cache on a dead rock, a derelict patrol frame still obeying half-erased orders, and a cleaned-up account of a massacre that leaves one medic unaccounted for, all hinting that something old and automatic has been steering him for years.
zh: 在残骸变稀薄、群星显得太近之处，这片墓地里最后一台仍在运转的机械仍在悄悄干活，沿一条没人记得谁批准过的线调度着幽灵般的分诊路线与撤离路径。只要那个逻辑回路继续运行，受伤的船与走投无路的船员就会继续朝同一方向漂去，而他总能有个理由守在它的尽头。在这里打断这条链，意味着切进某套被遗忘战争协议的中枢系统——赶在它把更多人拖进他手里之前。  \n目前为止，我只有一些模式碎片：死寂岩石上一处匿名储藏点、一具仍服从半擦除命令的弃置巡逻船架，以及一份把一名医疗兵留作"下落不明"的清白屠杀记录——全都暗示某种古老而自动的东西多年来一直在引导他。

#en: The Helium-3 plant hums like a caged storm, its vats and stacks bleeding heat into the thin air, the kind of place someone obsessed with the sky would hijack without ever setting foot planetside. Whatever she seeded into this line is feeding off the reactors and telemetry here, bending data and weather both, and as long as it lives in the machinery, every refinery ping and atmospheric readout is suspect. Cut it out here and the path she has been hiding behind those signals finally stands alone.  \nSo far the trail runs from a nameless fringe tip to guarded files at a frontier post, then to odd refinery diagnostics; in every room where this work is whispered, certain names vanish mid-sentence, replaced by shrugs and careful pronouns that all seem to circle back toward the same missing scientist and her unfinished storm.
zh: 那座氦-3 工厂像一头被关进笼子的风暴嗡鸣，它的罐体与烟囱把热量渗进稀薄的空气，是那种痴迷天空的人从不着陆就能劫持的地方。她播进这条链路的东西正以这里的反应堆与遥测为食，同时掰弯数据与天气；只要它活在机械里，每一次炼油脉冲与大气读数都不可信。在这里把它切掉，她一直藏在那些信号后面的路径终于会独自站住。  \n目前为止，线索从一条无名边境线报，到某座边境哨所里戒备的文件，再到古怪的炼油诊断；在每一间有人低声谈论这项工作的房间里，某些名字都会在句子中间消失，被耸肩与谨慎的代词取代——而它们似乎都绕回同一名失踪的科学家与她未完成的风暴。

#en: Out here, where the relay hangs in a thinning orbit no one admits still exists, she can work without oversight or witnesses, cutting and splicing grav lanes through a node that was quietly erased from every official chart. The old UC hardware still trusts her credentials, feeding her live routes and transponder chatter as she shapes a final correction that will send multiple ships into the same blind corridor, then burn the last proof of how she has been steering deaths and rescues for years. If she finishes, the pattern vanishes with the station, and everyone gets to pretend they never saw it coming. All I have are a discarded dataslate from a dead-end rock, half-sober rumors traded over Aurora in Neon, and blackened SysDef logs pulled from a drifting tactical hull, each one sketching the same unseen hand in the lanes.
zh: 在这里，在那座悬于一条没人承认仍存在的衰减轨道上的中继处，她能不受监督、没有证人在场地工作，通过一个被从所有官方星图上悄悄抹掉的节点剪切、拼接引力航道。旧联殖硬件仍信任她的凭证，把实时航线与应答器闲谈喂给她，任她塑成最后一次修正——那会把多艘船送进同一条盲走廊，然后烧掉"她多年来如何操纵死亡与救援"的最后证据。若她完工，这个模式就随星际站一同消失，所有人都能假装自己从没看出苗头。我只有一块来自死胡同岩石的废弃数据板、在霓虹城就着极光交易的半醉传闻，以及从一具漂移战术船壳里拉出的焦黑星防队日志，每一份都勾勒出航道中同一只无形的手。

#en: The old relay was never meant to live this long a stopgap node left running on borrowed power, its protocols flagged for decommissioning in some forgotten UC docket. Somewhere along the way, the patches and workarounds hardened into habit, and the station slipped from oversight into shadow, perfect cover for someone clever enough to feed new routes through old code. Now Vermin Gravepack squat in its hollowed corridors like rats in the wiring, guarding a single cache of traffic records and smuggler notes that does not match any official chart, a document that will show where the lanes have really been bending. So far the trail is faint a bloodied dataslate in a remote outpost, rumors of manufactured accidents in spacer bars, a damaged tug captain swearing a calm voice rewrote his course and paid him to forget the details.
zh: 那座旧中继本不该活这么久——一个靠借来的电力运行的临时节点，其协议在某个被遗忘的联殖案卷里早已被标记待退役。一路走来，那些补丁与变通硬化成了习惯，星际站从监督滑入阴影，成了某个聪明到能把新航线喂进旧代码之人的完美掩护。如今"害虫坟场帮"像线路里的老鼠一样蹲在它被掏空的走廊里，守着唯一一处交通记录与走私者笔记的储藏——它不与任何官方星图相符，是一份能显示航道真正在何处弯折的文件。目前为止，这条线索很淡：某座偏远前哨一块沾血的数据板、太空劫匪酒吧里关于"人造意外"的传闻，以及一名受损拖船船长发誓有个平静的声音改写了他的航向、并付钱让他忘掉细节。

#en: Out here, this prefab box of metal and dust is where bad luck gets written down and quietly misfiled, which is exactly why the trail has to be lifted from here and not from some polished office on Akila. The deputy's notes are messy, half for a local dispute and half for a string of implant failures no one ever officially linked, all cross-referenced on a personal tablet because the main system was "too busy" that day. One minor oversight, one unsubmitted report, and the pattern sat here, growing in the dark while more colonists signed the same contracts and woke up with the same whispers in their heads. So far I have a frontier investigator who saw just enough to be scared, a scattered list of failed upgrades from outlying clinics, and a name that keeps surfacing in complaints that never make it into the official queue.
zh: 在这里，这个金属与尘土的预制盒，是霉运被记录下来、并被悄悄错误归档的地方——这正是为什么线索必须从这里、而不是从阿基拉城某间光鲜的办公室里提取。那位副警长的笔记很乱：一半是本地纠纷，一半是一串从未被正式联系起来的植入体故障，全都交叉引用在一台私人平板上，因为主系统那天"太忙"。一次小小的疏忽、一份未提交的报告，模式就坐在这里，在黑暗中生长，而更多殖民者签下同样的合同、醒来时脑中响着同样的低语。目前为止，我有一名"看到的东西刚好够让他害怕"的边境调查员、一份来自外围诊所的失败升级零散清单，以及一个不断出现在从未进入官方队列之投诉里的名字。

#en: Out in the dim sliver of orbit where traffic control forgets to look, a lone Crimson Fleet hauler holds position just off the standard lanes, repeating the same lazy drift-and-burn pattern like a metronome. It has been doing that for weeks, maybe months, subtle shifts in timing that never quite rise to a violation, never quite trip an alarm. Rerouted freighters skim its shadow, patrol paths bend a few degrees wider, and each small adjustment disappears into routine until someone bothers to stack the plots side by side. I started with offhand complaints in a Neon lounge and half-scrubbed logs from a dead SysDef hull; now the private archive buried in Cydonia's back corridors and this ghost-patterned ship in orbit both point to the same conclusion, that her hand has been on these levers longer than anyone wanted to notice.
zh: 在交管系统忘记去看的那道昏暗轨道缝隙里，一艘孤零零的深红舰队货船停在标准航道外侧，像节拍器一样重复着同样懒散的"漂移—点火"模式。它已经这么做了一周、也许好几个月：时机上的细微偏移从未真正构成违规，也从未真正触发警报。被改道的货船贴着它的阴影掠过，巡逻路径弯宽了几度，每一处小小的调整都化进例行公事，直到有人费心把那些轨迹并排叠起来看。我最开始是从霓虹城一家酒廊里的随口抱怨，以及一具死掉星防队船壳里半擦除的日志入手的；如今，埋在赛多尼亚后走廊里的私人档案与轨道上这艘幽灵模式的船，都指向同一个结论：她的手搭在这些操纵杆上的时间，比任何人愿意注意到的都久。

#en: The remote research module is where the trail first bent out of sight, a half-forgotten node still tethered to corporate networks yet far enough from Neon's politics to be overlooked. Its servers once mirrored countless routine transfers, but someone with intimate access reached in and broke a single link in a data-theft chain, nudging stolen code and shipment logs just off their expected paths. In the process, they left the kind of hairline distortions only seen when you stack years of records together: routing quirks, repeating gaps, and an anomaly in the way certain neural design files simply never arrive where they should. Earlier sweeps of frontier clinics, smugglers' manifests, and a whisper from a nervous archivist all point back here, to the quiet machine that watched it happen and still remembers every deviation.
zh: 那座偏远研究舱，是线索第一次拐出视线的地方：一个半被遗忘的节点，仍系在公司的网络上，却离霓虹城的政治足够远、以至于被忽视。它的服务器曾镜像过无数例行传输，可有某个拥有内部权限的人伸手进来，打断了一条数据盗窃链上的单一环节，把被盗代码与货运日志轻推出它们预期的路径。在这个过程中，他们留下了那种只有把多年记录叠起来才能看见的细如发丝的畸变：路由怪癖、重复出现的空缺，以及某些神经设计文件"干脆从不抵达该去之处"的异常。早先对边境诊所、走私者舱单的排查，以及某名紧张档案员的一句低语，全都指回这里——那台安静看着它发生、并仍记得每一处偏差的机器。

#en: On this station that once ignited a war simply by existing in the wrong orbit, every corridor hums with the quiet certainty that medicine here is neutral, apolitical, clean. Yet the research decks and intake archives are precisely where small compromises become doctrine a misfiled case, an unchecked dosage pattern, a forgotten trial note, each a minor oversight that lets someone like Catalyst slip official protocols into the veins of people the system pretends not to see. Buried among years of emergency triage records and transfer authorizations is the thread she could not fully erase, a record of who she still treats and where they vanish afterward. So far, the trail has led from a dead courier freighted with diverted chems to whispers of a ghost medic aiding veterans and settlers, always just off the official manifests.
zh: 在这座仅因身处错误轨道就点燃一场战争的星际站上，每条走廊都嗡鸣着一种安静的笃定：这里的医学是中立的、不问政治的、干净的。然而研究甲板与收治档案正是小妥协变成信条的地方：一份归档错误的病例、一个无人核查的给药模式、一条被遗忘的试验备注，每一处都是小小的疏忽，让像"催化剂"这样的人把官方协议溜进那些系统假装看不见之人的血管里。埋在多年急救分诊记录与转运授权之间的，是她无法彻底抹掉的那根线——一份记录，写着她还治疗谁、以及他们之后消失去了哪里。目前为止，这条线索从一艘载着被截留药剂的死掉信使船，延伸到关于一名帮助老兵与定居者的幽灵医疗兵的低语——她总是恰好不在官方舱单上。

#en: Out here, this quiet research module is where corporate paranoia and outlaw ingenuity first brushed against each other, and the scuff marks never quite faded. This is where competing routes were modeled, where data streams split and recombined, where someone with Vector's instincts could decide which paths lived and which were quietly erased. The local systems still hum with half-sanitized access logs and aborted transfers, the kind of digital crossfire that only matters to people who know how to weaponize information and jump corridors in the same breath. What started as a stray dataslate on a forgotten rock, then smeared beacon echoes in high orbit, then a Trade Authority hull with impossible waste cycles, has now become a stack of "lucky" overlaps and recycled names that stopped feeling like chance about two clues ago.
zh: 在这里、在这座安静的研究舱，公司的偏执与法外之徒的巧思第一次相互擦碰，而那些擦痕从未真正褪去。这里正是竞争航线被建模、数据流被拆分又重组、某个有"向量"那种直觉的人能决定哪些路径存活、哪些被悄悄抹掉的地方。本地系统仍嗡鸣着半清理的访问日志与中断的传输，那种只有懂得"把信息武器化与跃迁走廊操弄在同一口气里完成"的人才在意的数字交火。起初只是被遗忘岩石上一块散落数据板，然后是高轨道上被拖抹的信标回声，再然后是一具带着不可能废料循环的贸易管理局船壳——如今它已成了一大堆"幸运"的重叠与被重复利用的名字，而大约两条线索之前，它们就不再像是巧合了。

#en: Neon's Astral Lounge is where routes are bought with whispers and lost with a single bad drink, so if she sold anyone a path the galaxy was not meant to see, the echo of that deal lives here. In the haze of Aurora and cheap soundproofing, smugglers and haulers trade more than stories; they pass on fragments of access, codes and ciphers scrawled on coasters then half-erased, like someone meant to come back and tidy the trail and simply never returned. Whatever was left behind in this corner of the lounge is not just another trinket; it is the one remaining thread tying her name to the shadow corridors everyone swears do not exist. Up to now all you have is a half-remembered rumor from barflies and the knowledge that certain haulers vanished after dealing with a Kyrgyz-born navigator whose work no one will admit to funding.
zh: 霓虹城的"星光酒廊"，是航线靠低语买入、因一杯喝坏而失去的地方；所以若她卖给过谁一条星系本不该看见的路径，那笔交易的余音就活在这里。在极光与廉价隔音的雾气中，走私者与货船船员交换的不只是故事；他们传递的是权限碎片——写在杯垫上、又被擦掉一半的代码与暗语，像有人打算回来收拾痕迹、却再没回来。留在酒廊这个角落里的东西不只是又一件小玩意；它是唯一一根仍把她的名字与所有人都发誓不存在的阴影走廊系起来的线。目前为止，你只有酒客们记忆模糊的一则传闻，以及一个认知：某些货船船员在与一名吉尔吉斯出生的领航员打交道后消失了，而没人愿意承认资助过她的工作。

#en: Out here, the old UC listening post hangs over the landscape like a forgotten accusation, its antennae still straining toward traffic patterns the Navy no longer admits exist. This is where Vector can work without interference, quietly rewriting the sky, tuning Grav Drives against the ghosts of archived signals pulsing through abandoned relays. Every encrypted ping he sends from here lets him stitch his ghost corridor closer to reality and scrub the last traces of his earlier tampering from official registries. If he finishes, the map itself changes and no tribunal will ever prove who moved the lanes. So far the trail has been a dataslate on a backworld, hushed corporate whispers in a quiet research module, and a derelict GalBank contract hauler stuffed with corrupted charts and one name threaded through every altered route.
zh: 在这里，那座旧联殖听音哨像一桩被遗忘的指控悬在大地之上，它的天线仍在朝着海军不再承认存在的交通模式伸探。"向量"能在这里不受干扰地工作，悄悄重写天空，把引力引擎调谐到那些通过废弃中继脉动的归档信号幽灵。他从这里发出的每一次加密脉冲，都让他把自己的幽灵走廊缝得更接近现实，并从官方登记册上擦掉他早先动手脚的最后一痕。若他完工，星图本身就会改变，而任何法庭都永远无法证明是谁移动了航道。目前为止，这条线索是一穷乡星上一块数据板、某座安静研究舱里压低的公司低语，以及一艘塞满损坏星图的盖尔银行合同弃置货船——每一个被改动的航线上都穿着一根同一个名字。

#en: If anyone is still keeping score on the missing ships, the numbers live here, in the rusted bones Deimos left to rot. The scrapyard squats on the edge of nowhere, a tangle of collapsed gantries and half-gutted frames, exactly the sort of place where routes get rewritten and manifests quietly disappear under new paint and old dust. Uniform Blacksteel holds the perimeter with the bored vigilance of people paid to look the other way, not to ask why so many condemned drives all died on the same corridors. The boardrooms and officers who ordered that pattern buried trusted time to smother the rumors, but the whispers never quite went away; a dead spacer's logs in orbit, then inconsistencies in yard reports, all hinting that someone has been steering wrecks into the dark and signing off on their erasure with the same careful hand.
zh: 若说还有人在给失踪船只记账，那些数字就活在这里，活在火卫二留下腐烂的锈蚀骨骼里。那片废料场蹲在天涯之外，一片坍塌的龙门架与被掏空一半的框架的乱麻，正是那种航线被改写、舱单在新油漆与旧尘土下悄悄消失的地方。"黑钢制服"以一种"被雇来转开视线、而非追问为何这么多报废引擎都死在同样几条走廊上"的无聊警惕守着周边。下令掩埋那个模式的董事们与军官们指望时间闷死传闻，可低语从未真正消失：轨道上一名死掉太空劫匪的日志，然后是船坞报告里的不一致，全都暗示有人一直在把残骸引向黑暗，并用同样一只谨慎的手签下它们的抹除。

#en: The old industrial shell still hums faintly with forgotten power, its rusted conduits and half-dead consoles the last place anyone would look for something worth killing over, which makes it exactly where a careful thief would tuck away the tool that rewrites how ships move through space. Whatever she lifted from her former associates will not just be schematics or raw numbers; it will be the working memory of jumps already taken, the kind of data that shows not only where she has been steering traffic, but where she intends the next bend in the lanes to fall. So far the trail is a discarded slate on a backwater world, convoy reports that blame "malfunction" instead of admitting a pattern, and whispering Fleet deserters who all agree on one thing: something vital went missing right before their routes started turning strange.
zh: 那座旧工业空壳仍带着一丝被遗忘电力的嗡鸣，它锈蚀的导管与半死的控制台，是任何人最不会去寻找"值得为之杀人"之物的地方——这让它恰好成了一名谨慎的窃贼藏匿"改写船只如何在太空中移动之工具"的地方。她从旧同伙那里拿走的，不会只是图纸或原始数字；那会是已经进行过的跃迁的工作记忆，那种不只显示她一直在把交通引向何处、还显示她打算让航道的下一个弯落在哪里数据。目前为止，这条线索是一穷乡世界上一块被丢弃的数据板、把"故障"当作借口而不肯承认模式的护航报告，以及低声说话的舰队逃兵——他们在一件事上达成一致：就在他们的航线开始变得古怪之前，某样至关重要的东西失踪了。
